Organization's website (fredfinch.org, branded 'Fred Finch Youth & Family Services') describes mental health, family and school/educational services for youth, matching OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' and special education contracts
research.notes: Phone main line is shown on the contact page with extension 5200; stored without extension. A related entity, Fred Finch Youth Center Cares Inc (EIN 81-4243450), also exists and was not used. WebSearch budget was exhausted, so candidates were found via the ProPublica API and the organization's own site; no OUSD mention was found on the organization's pages.

profile.summary: Fred Finch Youth & Family Services is a California nonprofit that provides services to children, teens, young adults and families facing complex challenges. Its programs include mental health services, family services, housing, young adult services, residential treatment and educational services. It has operated since 1891 and is based in Oakland.
